rules.requirement: UI apps adopt ui and use React, React DOM, TypeScript, Vite and @garden/ui; shared shadcn/Radix primitives own controls.
Desktop apps use Tauri 2 and Rust with the declared native titlebar configurations.
Services adopt daemon and use Bun, TypeScript and @garden/daemon-kit.
Markdown adoption includes @garden/markdown and @garden/editor; hosts supply storage and resolvers.

GAppShell owns the 46px titlebar, primary activity rail, independently collapsible contextual sidebar, top-right command field and optional right pane toggle; multi-workspace apps MUST use GActivityRail for major workspaces and GNavigation for destinations within the selected workspace, while single-workspace apps MAY omit the rail. Settings and conversations use their shared compositions.
No app title, wordmark or logo in in-app titlebars, headers, navigation sidebars or activity rails; identity belongs to OS metadata and About.
Page headers contain a task title and useful actions; omit greetings, promotional text, redundant subtitles and conversational filler.
Generated semantic tokens and shared components own geometry, monochrome chrome, inverse primary actions and stable editing surfaces.
Localized names, keyboard operation, visible control focus, focus restoration and compact-screen reachability are mandatory.
Use scoped toast, banner, inline error, empty state and modal behavior without duplicating one event across channels.
PDC owns canonical Markdown/HTML, readable legacy inputs, envelope semantics and preservation; Garden does not invent another canonical dialect.
Queries use only .base and exact fenced base blocks, explicit enablement and the declared capability subset; unsupported expressions stay visibly unexecuted.
GDocumentProperties and GDocumentEditor share typed, source-preserving metadata editing; technical fields follow the body in a disclosure.
No silent source loss, conversion, unsafe execution or unguarded overwrite; storage and resolver capabilities remain explicit.
Apps compose framework packages; native and filesystem IO belong to host adapters, not reusable React controls.
Run doctor, relevant builds/tests and the changed path in a running app/process; record actual evidence and limitations.
